## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-08-01 — do not edit manually*

### File Editing Strategy
*~20,000 tokens/session saved*
- Read exact surrounding line context before editing large core files (`ScraperView.tsx`, `nim.ts`, `SettingsView.tsx`, `src/app/api/scrape/route.ts`) to avoid `String to replace not found` edit failures.

### Environment & CLI Tools
*~15,000 tokens/session saved*
- Run Python scripts using `python_engine/venv/bin/python` or `./venv/bin/python` inside `python_engine/`.
- Do not use the `timeout` Linux CLI tool on macOS; use `curl -m <sec>` or Python timeout handlers instead.

### Server Management
*~12,000 tokens/session saved*
- Terminate background processes with `pkill -f "next"` and `pkill -f "uvicorn"` before launching local servers to prevent `EADDRINUSE` port conflicts.

### Scraper Dependencies
*~10,000 tokens/session saved*
- Run `./venv/bin/python -m playwright install chromium` inside `python_engine/` whenever setting up or testing Playwright SERP/stealth scrapers.

### Build & Type Verification
*~8,000 tokens/session saved*
- Verify TypeScript status using `npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "^\.next/types"` to filter Next.js framework type noise.
